jobs.title: SPECIAL EVENT Unarmed Security/ Bag Screener
jobs.description:
A temporary position for a 4-day event.

Job Overview:
We are seeking detail-oriented Security Screeners to join our Special Event Team. As a Security Screener, you will play a vital role in ensuring the safety and security of our premises and personnel. The ideal candidate will possess excellent communication skills, be punctual and reliable, and have a keen eye for detail.

Duties:

  • Inspect visitor bags, wagons, strollers, and other permitted items upon entry
  • Follow established screening and security procedures
  • Communicate screening requirements clearly and courteously
  • Remain alert and report suspicious activity or potential security concerns
  • Maintain a clean and organized screening area
  • Follow directions from event supervisors and security management

Requirements:

  • Valid Texas Level II Guard Card in hand
  • Previous security or screening experience
  • Dependable, punctual, and committed to completing all accepted shifts
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, public-facing environment
  • Ability to stand for extended periods, with or without reasonable accommodation
  • Ability to work outdoors in varying weather conditions
  • Clean and professional appearance and demeanor
  • Ability to follow strict security protocols and supervisor instructions
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to recognize potential security concerns

Attendance Bonuses will be active for this event, in addition to the stated hourly rate. Employees that work one full shift per day for ALL 4 days of the event, will earn a $100 bonus. Employees that work 2 full shifts per day for ALL 4 days of the event, will earn a $200 bonus. Bonuses added to paycheck.

This assignment is best suited for security professionals who are dependable, attentive, comfortable interacting with the public, and committed to completing their assigned shifts.

Job Type: Temporary

Pay: $17.00 per hour

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
Job Summary

Provides crime prevention and law enforcement responsibilities for the conduct of routine patrols, preliminary, criminal, and specialized investigations, and traffic control duties in a designated area during an assigned shift.

This position is a part-time officer and must meet the same qualifications and standards of a full-time officer.

STARTING SALARY

The starting salary of certified officers is based on the previous experience level of the applicant as full-time police officer. Experience as a reserve officer, constable, military service, military police, and jailer is not accepted.

Essential Functions

With limited supervision, this position operates in an assigned area(s) of the City of Grapevine and through the application of sound judgment developed through training, education, and experience, performs crime prevention and detection activities to enforce federal, state, and local laws, preserve the peace and protect property and lives. Typical duties include:

  • Patrols an assigned area to prevent and detect criminal activities, normally operating a city vehicle.
  • Responds to emergency calls to protect lives and property, often involving criminal activities. Apprehends suspected criminals as situation dictates.
  • Initiates applicable investigation techniques to develop and prosecute criminals under each offense.
  • Prepares reports to document investigative actions, interviews, interrogations, subpoena procurement; written statements; affidavits for evidentiary warrants and arrest warrants; evidence collection; identification, location and apprehension of perpetrator and property recovery. Submits these documents for supervisory review.
  • Prepares and presents cases to relevant courts, legal processes, and testifies when required.
  • Investigates non-criminal actions such as missing persons, internal affairs, found property, and other relevant requests for service.
  • Enforces traffic laws through patrol and issuance of citations.
  • Participates in Police Department crime prevention and education programs and activities.
  • Conducts specialized undercover investigations as assigned.
  • Performs related duties as directed when such duties are a logical and appropriate assignment to the position.
  • Interacts professionally and respectfully with the public, coworkers, and others in the course of daily work.
  • Maintains regular and timely attendance.

jobs.title: Security Guard - Grapevine, TX
jobs.description:
POSITION TITLE: SECURITY GUARD

LOCATION: GRAPEVINE, TX

HOURLY RATE: $17.50/HOUR

POSITION SUMMARY

Due to our continued growth, we are currently seeking a driven dynamic Security Guard to join our team. This position provides protection and performs security services of routine difficulty in maintaining the safety, security of persons, property in assigned buildings and grounds for multiple Company facilities.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

The Security Guard will have content expertise in the following areas. They will be responsible for the following reporting and communication requirements as deemed appropriate by the company:

  • Documenting incidents and reviewing reports before submitting them to their reporting supervisor.

  • Coordinate and conduct security-related training.

  • Enforcing security, safety & evacuation policies.

  • Serve as liaison to other Company departments and outside agencies regarding security issues.

  • Ensure compliance with Federal/State/Local agency security regulations and statutes.

  • Coordinate emergency responses.

  • Maintains lost and found.

  • Explains security procedures and may instruct employees/contractors.

  • Assists during safety drills; directs emergency evacuation until police/firemen arrive.

  • Checks and maintains security equipment.

  • Secures building area by locking and unlocking doors at scheduled times.

  • Required to de-escalate incidents and physically escort individuals from the property.

  • Maintains observation of areas following organized activities to keep records of any property damage.

  • Respond accordingly to emergencies to protect persons and property by going to the appropriate location; assessing the situation; following prescribed instructions; applying basic knowledge of first aid, CPR, and other emergency procedures as appropriate; and requesting additional assistance when needed.

  • Assist in building evacuations and searches to ensure occupants' safety by notifying them of the threatening situation(s), and providing instructions as directed.

  • Monitors TV and audio surveillance to check the building safety, security, and control, and notifies designated staff of emergencies.

  • Editing and labeling equipment per guidelines.

  • Audits surveillance system ensuring it is working properly and notifies management of service requests when needed.

  • Position daily surveillance in the parking lot to monitor traffic flow.

  • Monitors access, alarms, and cameras at all locations.

  • Work weekends, Holidays, nights, and extra hours when needed.

  • Other Duties as assigned.



KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES AND WORK ENVIRONMENT:

  • Active - Texas level II Security License.

  • Must be able to work any shift and any days.

  • Availability to work weekends when needed.

  • Ability to sit/stand/walk for long periods of time.

  • Must pass criminal background and drug screen prior to hire.

  • Ability to communicate effectively in English both orally and in writing.

  • Ability to effectively author reports stating complete facts.

  • Ability to react promptly and drive in a variety of conditions, both emergency and non-emergency.

  • Ability to solve varied and diverse problems that require deductive reasoning skills.

  • Ability to see, hear, and remember facts, people, and circumstances.

  • Ability to work independently with little supervision, self-motivated.

  • Knowledge of administrative rules, regulations and procedures governing security for assigned buildings and grounds sufficient to follow, enforce and explain them.

  • Knowledge of area(s) to which assigned, including office and facility locations, and where to seek assistance in emergency situations.

  • Knowledge of proper safety precautions and first aid techniques sufficient to deal effectively with emergency situations.

  • Ability to enforce regulations, reasonably but firmly.

  • Ability to follow simple oral and written directions.

  • Ability to prepare incident reports and maintain log records accurately and concisely.

  • Ability to demonstrate mental alertness, exercise good judgment in implementing instructions, and be trustworthy.

  • Ability to keep and maintain confidential information and data.

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

Work is performed in a company office building.

  • Lifting requirements of up to 50 pounds occasionally may be required.

  • Wrist and finger manipulation due to computer work, calculating, compiling, and filing.

  • The equipment used may include but is not limited to a computer, calculator, telephone, copy and fax machines.

  • Must be able to stand and sit for long hours.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

  • High school diploma or equivalent; higher education in a relevant field is a plus.

  • Proven experience in private security, military, or police, with at least five years in a similar role.

  • Valid Driver’s License

  • No Criminal History

  • Knowledge of security protocols, procedures, and best practices.

  • Strong leadership and interpersonal skills.

  • Excellent Verbal and written communication

  • Problem-solving abilities.

  • Ability to make decisions under pressure and respond effectively to emergencies.

  • Proficient in using security-related technology and systems.

  • Training or certification in security management is preferred.

jobs.description:
About First Responder Protective Services


First Responder Protective Services is a premier provider of private security needs across the U.S. Our company is owned, operated and managed by U.S. Military veterans, law enforcement executives, and corporate business professionals. Our founders have over 60 years of experience in protecting critical infrastructures, combating transnational criminal organizations, mitigating risks, and providing the highest level of safety and security to corporations and communities.


The mission of First Responder Protective Services is to provide the highest level of customer service to each and every client. We accomplish this mission through our foundation of attention to detail, integrity, accountability, empathy, care, and concern for the needs of our clients and the officers which we serve.


Job Title: Non-Commissioned Security Guard (Level II)
Location: Grapevine
Pay: $18-$20 per hour, depending on qualifications (paid weekly)
Status: Full-time & Part-time

Position Summary


First Responder Protective Services (FRPS) is hiring multiple FLEX Non-Commissioned Security Guards to provide a consistent security presence at a controlled-access community in the Grapevine area. This position is primarily based in a spacious, climate-controlled guard shack, where officers will manage access control, monitor video surveillance and access systems, and check residents and visitors in and out of the property. The guard shack is equipped with basic necessities and access to clean, private restroom facilities. Officers will also conduct occasional patrols of the property, both on foot and by golf cart, to maintain visibility and ensure the safety of residents and property. Weekday and weekend shifts are available, with 24/7 coverage required.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage check-in/out residents and visitors in a climate controlled shack.
  • Monitor entrances, access points, and surveillance systems.
  • Respond promptly to alarms, emergencies, or incidents.
  • Prepare detailed incident and activity reports as required.
  • Remain alert and proactive in identifying and reporting security concerns
  • Follow all post orders and supervisor instructions
  • Occasional mobile and foot patrol in assigned areas to ensure safety and security of residents, staff, and property.


Requirements

  • Must have at least one year of experience unarmed security.
  • Must hold a current Level II Texas Noncommissioned Security License
  • Must have a valid Texas Driver’s License (or ability to obtain before starting)
  • Professional appearance and demeanor
  • Ability to work independently or with a team
  • Able to sit, stand, or walk for extended periods

Part Time position:

Uniform & Equipment

Compensation & Advancement

  • Hourly Pay: $18-$20/hour (based on experience and availability)
  • Pay Frequency: Bi-weekly via direct deposit
  • Status: W2 employee (eligible for overtime after 40 hours in a workweek)
  • Shifts: 8 hours per day


Full-Time Employee Benefits

    • 5th Year and beyond: Accrue up to 15 days (120 hours)

jobs.title: Event Operations Manager
jobs.description:
About the Role

Andy Frain Services is on the lookout for a motivated and detail-oriented Event Operations Manager to play a key role in driving event operations across our premier Sports & Entertainment venues. You will primarily focus on Fair Park/State Fair of Texas.

In this dynamic role, you will partner directly with the Account Manager to oversee event day operations, lead the security team, and ensure exceptional safety and experiences for fans, promoters, sponsors, and vendors.

Work Schedule Note: Flexibility is essential as this position involves a dynamic, event-driven schedule, including evenings, weekends, and holidays based on the venue calendar.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive Salary: Commensurate with experience
  • Time Off: Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance options
  • Retirement: 401(k) retirement savings plan
  • Career Advancement: Opportunities for leadership development and professional growth within a nationally recognized industry leader

Key Responsibilities

Event Operations & Venue Leadership

  • Act as the operational lead for smaller events and manage concurrent venue dates across Dallas.
  • Oversee event-day execution, ensuring that security requirements and client standards are met.
  • Lead staff sign-in/sign-out processes and manage accurate post-event payroll and billing.
  • Serve as the primary lead in the Account Manager's absence.

Staffing, Onboarding & Development

  • Assist in the onboarding, training, scheduling, and management of event-day staff and supervisors.
  • Conduct pre-event briefings for teams of varying sizes, from small groups to over 600 personnel.
  • Monitor monthly event metrics and assess staff performance indicators.
  • Coach and mentor supervisors and staff on personnel matters in accordance with company policy.

Logistics & Equipment Management

  • Oversee the storage, distribution, maintenance, and tracking of venue equipment.
  • Prepare operational materials and documentation for event-day supervisors.
  • Submit equipment and supply requests 45 days in advance of the operational needs.

Risk Management, Safety & Client Relations

  • Identify and address potential safety risks for guests and staff.
  • Regularly meet with venue clients to ensure security, emergency preparedness, and safety compliance.
  • Ensure compliance with Federal and State OSHA, fire, and safety regulations.
